intro1.message: The gate's open because Sylvie vouches for you. Don't make her regret it.
intro1.teach: Sylvie said you could teach me to farm.

introLetter.message: Hm. Her hand. All right. She says you carry silk through the Elderwood. That counts for something.
introLetter.opt1: She talks about you a lot.

introSeeds.message: You've already found seeds, walker. Monsters carry wild seed, a few in every dozen. Everything that stuck to you since the beach went into the Guild's tally. It doesn't weigh on your pack.

introSeedsWhy.message: You wouldn't. A seed's small and a fight's loud. The list left of the plots is your tally. Slimes, gulls, deer, goats: they all carry some.

introNoSeeds.message: Nothing in the tally yet. Monsters carry wild seed, a few in every dozen. Meanwhile I sell turnip seed, twenty gold. Plant that first.

introGate.message: Through the gate, then. Plot one's yours. Pick a seed from the list, then pick the plot.

default.tableTurnIn: The stew and the pie are ready.
default.aboutGate: Why did you close the gate?

aboutGuild.message: Growers. Seed lines kept pure and passed hand to hand. Two winters ago half the vaults sprouted black. We shut the gate. Now we need hands.

aboutGate.message: Closed it. Not sorry. The sap came through the Spires and took half of what we had. A stranger could have carried more.

questFurrow.message: First lesson. Plant turnip. Four, to start. Plot one, pick the seed, wait fifteen minutes. Go hit something. Dirt doesn't care how brave you are.

questFurrowProgress.message: Four turnips. Through the gate, plot one. Fifteen minutes, walker.

questFurrowComplete.message: Not bad. First one's yours to eat. I'll pay you in coin and seed. And I've an order for you now, if you want the work.

questWheat.message: Wheat now. Ten. The plots run side by side, so use more than one. Slimes carry the seed. I sell it too, once you're Friendly.

questWheatProgress.message: Ten wheat, walker. Forty-five minutes a plot. Use two.

questWheatComplete.message: Ten! In a day. Well. Here's the Guild's bread recipe, and my thanks. Wick has something for you, too.

questOrchard.message: The orchard burned in the sap winter. Twelve apples from our own trees would say the Guild is open again. Goats on the Pass carry the seed. The trees take four hours.

questOrchardProgress.message: Twelve apples. Goats on the Mountain Pass carry the seed. Four hours a tree.

questOrchardComplete.message: Apples. From our own ground. ... Take a plot. A new one, by the south wall. It's yours.

questTable.message: Honored folk get my pie recipe, walker. It's in the shop. Cook me five turnip stew and five harvest pie. I haven't cooked in two years.

questTableProgress.message: Five stew, five pie. Fire Pit for the stew, Cooking Pot for the pie. Cheese from a Giant Rat, or buy it. Rats don't make cheese, walker. They steal it.

questTableComplete.message: ... Warm. Salt's right. Sit. I'll eat first. Take the plot. And tell Corwin the Guild has bread.

orderOffer.message: The larder is low. I need crops, and the Guild pays for them. Bring what the quest panel says.

orderProgress.message: The order's in your quest panel, walker. The plots won't hurry for you.

orderComplete.message: That'll do. Come back in two hours, walker.

petGift.message: There's a hare on the terraces. Nobody keeps it. It keeps itself. Feed it and it will find the ripe row first. It likes you.

petGiftDone.message: Hand of the Terraces. That is what the Guild calls you now. Wear it well, walker.
